instructions.operand: Our mod has the ability to modify how the healthbars of certain bosses appear. Pick the one that suits you most.
"SIMPLE" : Render the healthbar in a simple custom texture.
"FANCY" : Render the healthbar in a fancy custom texture.
Select the "DEFAULT" option on a boss to have the setting follow the default one.

Will the camera rotate when rolling while in first-person view
Will there be a GUI element displaying current roll count
GUI anchors are preset locations for the rolling GUI visual to appear. Pick the one that suits you most.
"HOTBAR_RIGHT" : At the immediate right of your hotbar.
"HOTBAR_LEFT" : At the immediate left of your hotbar.
"TOP_LEFT" : In the top left corner of your screen.
"TOP_RIGHT" : In the top right corner of your screen.
"BOTTOM_LEFT" : In the bottom left corner of your screen.
"BOTTOM_RIGHT" : In the bottom right corner of your screen.
"SCREEN_CENTER" : At the exact middle of your screen?
You can also additionally offset the GUI element with the use of the X and Y offset values.
Roll GUI element X offset (Bigger number goes right, negative goes left)
Roll GUI element Y offset (Bigger number goes down, negative goes up)
